packageRules.description: Private site repos, fetched over the github-<repo> SSH aliases: bump them with `make update-sites`. (Also why lockFileMaintenance is off: a whole-lock update fetches them; per-input updates don't.)
One weekly PR for the branch-tracking inputs. Merging it is the deploy: the nightly auto-upgrade builds main.
prBodyNotes: Before merging: `make test-server`, and if Caddy's version moved, update the `withPlugins` hash in `hosts/jenkosrv-fsn1-3` (nix prints the one it got). Merging deploys it to the server at the next auto-upgrade.

packageRules.description: Pinned to release tags on purpose (see flake.nix): one PR per release, never grouped.
prBodyNotes: Pinned deliberately: read the release notes before merging.
